baseline.source: TEST ONLY: exact synthetic baseline in an isolated library. PA-41 must capture the operational file and protect its baseline library.
baseline.byteRule: Read and compare full contentBase64 to the protected file before every candidate. The first candidate bytes are exactly the baseline bytes. Empty is allowed; nonempty ends in one LF and has one JSON object per line.
baseline.failure: Missing, changed, unreadable, or unverified baseline blocks publication. PA-41 must replace synthetic metadata with a verified operational capture before activation.

approvedInput.batchState: Approved only; ignore every other state
approvedInput.itemOrder: Included manifest rows in SourceItemId ascending order
checks: ProjectionDigest equals b64-edge-v1 fingerprint of exact manifest bytes
one valid UTF-8 JSON object per row
unique submissionId across baseline and approved rows
revision predecessor and root resolve in baseline or earlier approved rows
PeriodKey, PeriodStartUtc, PeriodEndUtc, and PolicyRevision present
approvedInput.digestRule: The PA-37B fingerprint is diagnostic and cannot prove integrity alone. Full encoded-byte comparison proves frozen file equality; local acceptance also records SHA-256 of exact bytes.

candidate.construction: baseline bytes followed by each approved frozen row's exact bytes and one LF
candidate.replay: Same baseline and Approved snapshots produce byte-identical output. A later Approved batch may append only after every earlier byte.
candidate.error: Any invalid Approved batch fails the entire run before publication; never silently omit it.

publication.previousRead: Accept complete successful read or explicit 404 only
publication.unchanged: Skip write after exact encoded-byte equality
publication.write: One conditional SharePoint write with connector retries disabled; a confirmed 404 uses overwrite=false
publication.uncertainOutcome: Read and compare complete expected bytes; do not roll back over a later file
publication.success: After exact logbook readback, fetch a nonempty SharePoint file ETag, write a run-unique receipt, and reread the receipt exactly. A failed receipt step fails the run.
publication.fingerprintLimit: candidateFingerprint is diagnostic, not a cryptographic digest; independent SHA-256 is recorded in acceptance evidence.

rollback: Disable approval-aware trigger, retain last verified file, and keep old unfiltered trigger disabled. Redeploy from the accepted package only after reconciling the file and approved snapshots.
